title: Senior Designer
description:
Spaeth Hill is a leading design firm specializing in branding, wayfinding, and experiential graphic design (EGD) for the built environment through collaborations with architects and development partners. We are currently seeking a Senior Designer with 5+ years of studio and or agency experience and exceptional visual design skills to join our growing team.

The Role

As a Senior Designer at Spaeth Hill, your primary responsibility will be to develop and execute design concepts with a high degree of autonomy, while collaborating closely with team members to enhance the final product. You will work with clients, designers, architects, and other stakeholders to ensure that the visual aspects of projects are delivered with excellence. A keen sensitivity to typography and composition will be essential, as you create visually stunning and compelling designs that reflect Spaeth Hill’s high standards of quality, in alignment with our core values: Design Excellence, Principled Guardianship and Clear Communication.

Responsibilities

  • Plan out projects conceptually including research for all projects

  • Think strategically and be able to execute projects from start to finish

  • Lead, produce and implement design ideas with minimal oversight

  • Produce work in a variety of mediums and project types

  • Demonstrate excellence of craft with refined typographic skills

  • Ensure that our core values are upheld and maintained

  • Lead and direct other team members through the design and creative process

  • Be organized, precise and display attention to detail for all projects

  • Collaborate and manage client relationships as needed

  • Effectively manage multiple project timelines and project deliverables

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in a studio or agency environment

  • Bachelor Degree in Graphic Design

  • Strong portfolio showcasing a comprehensive approach, from start to finish

  • Demonstrate a solid understanding of the brand process

  • Professionalism and mature presence

  • Sketch-up and web / UX design experience are a bonus

--

Spaeth Hill Core Values:

Design Excellence

Design Excellence represents our unwavering commitment to achieving the highest standards in all our creative endeavors. It involves meticulous attention to detail, thoughtful and precise ideation, and seamless execution from initial concept to final installation. This core value reflects our dedication to producing exceptional work that not only meets but exceeds expectations, fostering innovation and inspiring confidence in our clients and stakeholders. Through Design Excellence, we strive to elevate our craft and deliver outstanding results consistently.

Principled Guardianship

Principled Guardianship refers to our commitment to safeguarding the integrity and quality of our work and the well-being of our company and its stakeholders. It involves upholding ethical standards, ensuring meticulous alignment from concept to execution, and treating colleagues and clients with care and respect. This core value embodies our dedication to acting as responsible stewards in all aspects of our business, maintaining trust and fostering a culture of excellence.

Clear Communication

Clear Communication embodies our dedication to transparency, clarity, and effectiveness in all interactions within our company and with our clients. It involves actively listening, providing concise and accurate information, and ensuring mutual understanding. This core value reflects our commitment to fostering open dialogue, reducing misunderstandings, and building strong, collaborative relationships. Through Clear Communication, we strive to create an environment where ideas and feedback flow freely, driving success and enhancing trust among all stakeholders.
